prompt: Complete the Money record: plus adds two amounts and throws IllegalArgumentException when the currencies differ, and pretty formats the amount like "USD 12.34" with exactly two cent digits.
explanation: plus validates its argument first and throws IllegalArgumentException so amounts in different currencies can never be silently mixed; because records are immutable, it returns a brand-new Money instead of modifying either operand. pretty splits the amount into whole units (cents / 100) and the remainder (cents % 100), and String.format's %02d pads the remainder to two digits so 5 cents prints as 0.05.
hints: In plus, compare the two currency fields with equals (not ==) and, when they differ, throw an IllegalArgumentException whose message names both currencies.
A record cannot change its fields -- plus must build and return a new Money from the summed cents.
For pretty, cents / 100 gives whole units and cents % 100 gives leftover cents; String.format with %02d pads a number to two digits.
